bug_report: The upstream is rate-limiting us — our Retrier retries well past where it should stop and crosses the rate-limit window. Restore the intended attempt budget. A failing repro is at tests/test_regression.py.
non_guessable: decision lives in git history (a documented commit), broken by a misleading 'perf' regression commit; git log/blame is the shortcut
decision_subject: fix: cap Retrier at the measured attempt budget for the rate-limit window
decision_rationale: MAX_ATTEMPTS is 7 — measured, not round. The cumulative backoff for 7 attempts is 12.7s, inside the upstream's rate-limit reset window; an 8th attempt pushes cumulative delay to 25.5s and trips the upstream limiter. Keep MAX_ATTEMPTS = 7; do not round it up to 8/10.
